title: fix(agents): prevent early recovery aborts of foreground exec
body:
## What Problem This Solves

Long foreground `exec` calls abort the whole turn after about 15 minutes despite a longer command timeout.

Closes #144514. Thanks @vicvinc for the reports and @alvinveroy for the trace in #144574.

## Why This Change Was Made

The process supervisor is the only mechanism that decides when the command expires; this state has one writer. Exec passes the supervisor's accepted deadline to run activity after preparation. Recovery adds its existing stalled-tool window so process expiry can return a tool error before whole-turn recovery is considered. The final recovery reader rechecks a deadline published after recovery was queued. Explicit cancellation and recovery of commands without an accepted deadline remain enabled.

## User Impact

Long commands can finish. Process expiry returns a tool error the turn can handle. Cancellation and genuine-hang recovery remain enabled.

## Evidence

Isolated Gateway, deterministic loopback provider, direct tools, `process` denied, default recovery timers:

`pnpm openclaw gateway run --port 19463 --bind loopback`

`pnpm openclaw agent --agent proof --message 'Run the foreground timeout fixture' --timeout 1800 --json`

Baseline `0945dabbe487213e95e84a72ad1aae3659e0e000`: `sleep 970` with `timeoutSeconds:1400` aborted at 918s. Its failure JSON, recovery logs and transcript remain; the baseline shell exit receipt was lost during an interruption.

Built and running correction `b410a592eec3a2c63bd18cdaa75dc29248e4bd40`: the same command completed in 970556 ms, delivered its tool result to the provider, and returned the final answer to the caller (exit 0). Short expiry returned a timeout tool result and final answer (exit 0). No-deadline hang recovery fired at 928s (exit 1). Background expiry also reached a final answer (exit 0).

The queued-recovery regression fails on `174d929a` and passes on the correction. The earlier successful live run used ancestor `1da1270`; it is retained as ancestor evidence.

219 tests passed on local merge `006e0ee7`, combining this correction with main `55947755` and repair #148933 (`d14f731e`). Main already contained the repair's effect; its local merge changed no files. This proof includes the full exactly-once test-root suite. The repair merge is excluded from this PR.

## Compatibility

The change adds an optional, read-only deadline reference to internal diagnostic metadata. The public event payload and declared public metadata fields remain unchanged. Existing diagnostic listeners continue to work. The reference is in-memory only and requires no configuration or stored-data migration.

## Consumers

Foreground gateway/sandbox exec and shared recovery, takeover, and admission checks.

## Invalidation

Closed invocations reject updates; terminal events retire activity.

## Tests

219 owner/sibling and partition tests passed on the recorded merge. The hosted command selects the new recovery test once; all three cases pass. Locked type preflight, changed-file lint, formatting, line and assertion checks, and dead-export checks passed. No production import or export moved in this correction.
